Dot-keepers for read_vcf

Source: R/vcf.R
dots_keepers_read_vcf.Rd

Return the set of ... arguments supported by read_vcf(). This builds on the global core keepers and adds/removes any read_vcf-specific arguments.

Usage

dots_keepers_read_vcf(extra = NULL, exclude = NULL)

Arguments

extra

Default: extra = NULL.

exclude

Default: exclude = NULL.
